brief_summary: Canonical ultra-modern Lovable-style motion — hero-act + scrub-tied parallax + section-fade-up, smoothed by Lenis

license.operator_instruction: npm i gsap. Free tier covers ScrollTrigger + core. Club plugins (SplitText, MorphSVG, DrawSVG) require commercial license.

key_animations.name: hero-reveal
key_animations.spec: headline letter-mask reveal (1.2s ease-out-expo) + subhead fade-up (lag 180ms) + cta fade-in (lag 360ms)

key_animations.name: image-parallax
key_animations.spec: image translateY(0) → translateY(-20%) over its viewport-pass

key_animations.name: cta-magnetic-hover
key_animations.spec: button translates 8px toward cursor + slight scale 1.02 (300ms ease-out)
